column1: # RECORDED READING -- .219, 16 GB M4 Mini, v1.0.33, DURING install, 2026-08-17.
# Five lsof samples ~2s apart, deduplicated. COMMAND<TAB>PID<TAB>REMOTE.
# This is the capture that proved the probe's original inclusion filter blind.
# Under 'ostler|Ostler|qdrant|oxigraph|ollama|mkdocs' it kept only the four
# loopback ollama rows and PASSED. The six outside-boundary rows below were
# held by curl, limactl and tailscale, none of which matched.
# PIDs are synthetic. They are not part of any assertion and the real ones say
# nothing useful about a reading taken once on one box.
# Destinations are recorded as addresses and deliberately NOT attributed to
# owners here. Reverse DNS was unavailable when this was captured, and naming
# an owner from memory is the error this whole file exists to stop. Attribution
# is the next piece of work, and it is the artefact -- see task #722.
